note: _septuaginta quatuor milia sescentorum_ (Benedictine Vulgate, Weber/Gryson) – seventy-four thousand and six hundred. One would expect _sescenti_ (nominative plural), and not genitive plural _sescentorum_. Friedrich Stummer (_Theologische Revue_ 36 [1937] 308) calls it a vulgarism. The Clementina has _sexcenti_, the Nova Vulgata _sescenti_.
